title: FEFCO 0201 vs 0427: Which Box Fits Your Shipment?
seo_title: FEFCO 0201 vs 0427: Carton or Mailer for Shipping?
description: Compare FEFCO 0201 shipping cartons and 0427 mailers by pack-out, stacking and total cost. Use one sample brief to quote both from Vietnam.
excerpt: Start with a taped 0201 for palletized loads or a hinged 0427 for shallow ecommerce kits. Use the same product and route to compare loaded samples and quote both styles.

incoming.before: The carrier's rounding rule can matter more than a few millimetres

title: Cupcake Box Sizes: How to Measure Boxes and Inserts
seo_title: Cupcake Box Sizes & Insert Fit: 4, 6 and 12 Count
description: Use the 4-, 6- and 12-count cupcake box size chart. Measure the liner, frosting and lid clearance before ordering custom inserts from Vietnam.
excerpt: Size 4-, 6- and 12-count boxes from the widest frosting, the liner where the tray supports it, and the clearance under the closed lid. Use the chart to start a sample.

baseline.title: Cupcake Box Sizes: How to Measure Boxes and Inserts

title: Glassine Bags for Bakeries: Choosing the Right Bag
seo_title: Glassine Bags for Bakeries: How to Choose & Test
description: Choose glassine bags for bakery cookies. Compare usable size, print contrast and oil transfer on filled samples before ordering from Vietnam.
excerpt: Try glassine when shoppers need to see the cookie. Compare finished bags using the same recipe and service window, then check fit, oil transfer and logo readability.
